The school principal, Mrs. Brijesh Jadon, stated that the school had been lacking computer education for a long time. In response to a request by the school secretary, Mr. Milkhan Singh Tomar, the Rotary Club of Agra took the initiative to establish this modern computer lab for the students. The school manager, Mr. K.K. Mohanty, expressed gratitude to the Rotary Club for its support.
Rotary Club President, Rotarian Namrata Panicker, emphasized that the club has been actively working in several schools across the city and is always ready to serve wherever there is a need. She also highlighted that this computer lab was established with the full support of senior club member Rotarian Ram Saran Mittal.
The event was graced by the presence of Rotarian Rajeev Lochan Bhardwaj, Rotarian L.D. Agrawal, Rotarian Rajesh Jain, Rotarian Digambar Singh, Rotarian Ira Sharma, Rotarian Sunil Kapoor, Rotarian Mukesh Chaturvedi, Rotarian Manoj Kumar, and other distinguished guests.

activities.title: Water Plant, Cycle Stand & Pavement Construction
activities.description:
The Rotary Club of Agra successfully completed the installation of clean drinking water facilities, a bicycle stand, and a footpath at Vivekananda Saraswati Vidya Mandir, located in Agra Cantt. These facilities were inaugurated by Major Donor Rotarian Ram Saran Mittal in the presence of club officials.
Rotary Club of Agra President, Rotarian Namrata Panicker, stated that the club is continuously working in the fields of education and healthcare. She acknowledged the significant contribution of senior club member Rotarian Ram Saran Mittal in making these initiatives possible and reaffirmed the club’s commitment to continuing such service projects in the future.
The school principal, Mr. Manendra Tiwari, expressed gratitude to the club for its generous contribution. The event was attended by Rotarian Rajeev Lochan Bhardwaj, Rotarian Rajesh Jain, Rotarian Ira Sharma, Rotarian Sunil Kapoor, Rotarian Mukesh Chaturvedi, Rotarian Manoj Kumar, along with Mr. Ashok Sharma, Mr. O.P. Garg, Mr. Pushpendra Singh, and other distinguished guests.

activities.title: Vandita - Celebration Of Unsung Sheroes
activities.description:
Under the joint auspices of Rotary Club of Agra and Shivalik Public School, the ‘Vandita’ program was organized to honor 15 women from various fields who have made remarkable contributions to society. Despite their significant impact, these women have remained largely unrecognized. Through this initiative, both the Rotary Club and the school acknowledged and appreciated their invaluable contributions.
President of Rotary Club of Agra, Mrs. Namrata Panicker, stated, “We often recognize only those who remain in the limelight, but it is equally important to honor women who selflessly work at the grassroots level to bring about real change in society.”
Principal of Shivalik Public School, Mrs. Vandana Shukla, emphasized the institution’s commitment to social responsibility, saying, “Along with providing quality education, we actively contribute to social welfare, and this event is a vital part of that mission.”
The keynote speaker, writer, and literary figure Mrs. Bhavana Vardan Sharma, highlighted the role of women in society, stating, “Every day should be celebrated as Women’s Day. Women learn to struggle for their existence from birth, and this struggle continues throughout their lives. The respect for women in society will only grow when we begin instilling these values in our children from home.”
The event featured cultural performances by the students, adding a special charm to the occasion. Principal Mrs. Vandana Shukla extended her best wishes to all the ‘Vanditas’ and expressed gratitude to the Rotary Club of Agra for their support.
Distinguished members from the Rotary Club, including Rotarian Srishti Jain, Rotarian Gunjan Girish Singh, Rotarian Jitendra Jain, and Rotarian Manoj R. Kumar, were present at the event.

activities.title: Seminar - Evolution Of Women's Right
activities.description:
On the occasion of International Women's Day, Rotary Club of Agra and B.D. Jain Girls P.G. College jointly organized a seminar on the topic "The Evolotion of Women's Rights." The discussion focused on the historical journey of women's rights and various aspects of their empowerment in society.
Advocate Namrata Mishra, the keynote speaker, shared her insights, stating, "The fight for women's rights was not fought by women alone; aware and progressive men also played a crucial role in challenging social evils such as the Sati system, the prohibition of widow remarriage, and the practice of triple talaq. Today, it is essential that the laws enacted for women's protection are used judiciously to maintain justice and harmony in society."
Rotarian Namrata Panicker, President of the Rotary Club of Agra, emphasized, "Women now have equal rights in society, but it is the responsibility of educated women to raise awareness among uneducated women around them about their rights and the government schemes designed for their benefit."
Professor Vandana Agarwal, Principal of the institution, addressed the students and encouraged them to stay aware of their rights and pledge never to misuse them.
Program Coordinator Professor Anuradha Gupta remarked, "A society can truly progress only when men and women function as two equal wheels of the same vehicle, maintaining balance and harmony." She expressed her gratitude to the Rotary Club of Agra for organizing such a meaningful event.
The program was skillfully moderated by Mrs. Neelam, and the event saw the presence of several distinguished guests, including Rotarian Manoj Kumar.

activities.title: Dinner Meet - Holi Milan Samaroh

Lively Holi songs, energetic dance performances, and a colorful ambiance created a truly festive experience. activities.title: Intercity Cricket Tournament
activities.description: रोटरी क्लब अलीगढ़ सिटी द्वारा दो दिवसीय 14 वें क्रिकेट टूर्नामेंट आगरा जोन का आयोजन धर्म समाज डिग्री कॉलेज अचल रोड पर 7 मार्च एवं 8 मार्च को संपन्न हुआ। इस टूर्नामेंट में कुल 8 टीमों ने सहभागिता की । फाइनल मुकाबला रोटरी क्लब अलीगढ एवं रोटरी क्लब पर्ल के बीच खेला गया। पहले खेलते हुए रोटरी क्लब अलीगढ ने 12 ओवर में 8 विकेट के नुकसान पर 153 रन बनाये , जिसके जबाब में रोटरी क्लब पर्ल 12 ओवर में 6 विकेट के नुकसान पर 105 रन ही बना सका , इस तरह से इस टूर्नामेंट को रोटरी क्लब अलीगढ ने 48 रन से जीत लिया। रोटरी क्लब पर्ल के खिलाड़ी करन गुप्ता को मैच के सर्वश्रेष्ठ खिलाडी घोषित किया गया। कार्यक्रम के मुख्य अतिथि PDG मुकेश सिंघल एवं विशिष्ट अतिथि अनुपम गुप्ता AG थे। इस टूर्नामेंट को सफल बनाने में अध्यक्ष संजय गर्ग, सचिव घनश्याम दस माहेश्वरी , अनूप गुप्ता , अम्ब्रीश गर्ग, प्रमोद चौधरी, संदीप विजयवर्गीय , कमल कांत वार्ष्णेय, संजू राजा , निषिद्ध जैन , संजय कुमार गोयल, देवेश चन्द्रा का योगदान रहा।

activities.title: Holi Celebration
activities.description: रोटरी क्लब अलीगढ सिटी द्वारा राधा वन, आगरा रोड, अलीगढ में रंगारंग होली उत्सव समारोह फूलों की होली खेल कर, चंदन तिलक एवं अबीर गुलाल लगाकर 11 मार्च को मनाया गया। कार्यक्रम के मुख्य अतिथि PDG मुकेश सिंघल थे। क्लब अध्यक्ष संजय कुमार गर्ग द्वारा सभी सदस्यों और अतिथियों का स्वागत करते हुए बताया कि होली का त्योहार बसंत ऋतु के आगमन और बुराई पर अच्छाई की विजय का प्रतीक है। क्लब सचिव घनश्याम दस माहेश्वरी ने कहा कि हमें इसे पर्यावरण को बचाते हुए परम्परागत रूप से मनाना चाहिए। इसके साथ ही कार्यक्रम में कलाकारों के द्वारा ब्रज संस्कृति पर आधारित होली की प्रस्तुति दी गई इसमें फूलों की होली, राधाकृष्ण की होली को प्रस्तुत किया गया। संगीत, होली के गीतों पर नृत्य और स्वादिष्ट चाट एवं भोजन के साथ कार्यक्रम सम्पन्न हुआ। कार्यक्रम संयोजक गौरव गोयल और उनकी धर्म पत्नी निशा गोयल को कार्यक्रम के भव्य आयोजन के लिए आभार व्यक्त किया। कार्यक्रम में पी सी गुप्ता, अनिल गुप्ता, प्रमोद चौधरी, संजय कुमार गोयल, अम्ब्रीश गर्ग, प्रदीप गर्ग, विनीत अग्रवाल, अंकुश अग्रवाल, अनूप गुप्ता, दीपक जिंदल, मुकेश जैन आदि उपस्थित रहे।

The Rotary Club of Aligarh actively participated in the "Shrimad Bhagwat Katha" organized by the Rotary Club of Mathura Central, held in Mathura from February 5th to 12th. रुद्रपुर, 26 जनवरी 2025: रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर द्वारा गणतंत्र दिवस बड़े उत्साह और जोश के साथ रोटरी भवन में मनाया गया। कार्यक्रम की शुरुआत क्लब अध्यक्ष रोटेरियन जयप्रकाश अग्रवाल, रो.ओम सिंघला, रो. रमन सिब्बल, ऐवम वेंकटेशमूर्ति (Sansera) और अशुतोष शर्मा जी के द्वारा ध्वजारोहण के साथ हुई। इस अवसर पर अतिथि के रूप में अविनाश सिंह ( बजाज ),पंकज मित्तल और गोपाल जी ( ग्लोब इंडस्ट्रीज), नरेश जी ( इम्पीरियल ऑटो ) , डॉ. मनदीप ( केएमसी हॉस्पिटल) , गायक रितेश मनोचा , इनरव्हील सदस्य, सीए सुनील झावर, 20 इंटरैक्ट छात्र सदस्य और रोटरी सहेली सेंटर के 65 छात्राएं उपस्थित रही!
कार्यक्रम के तहत इंटर स्कूल सोलो सिंगिंग प्रतियोगिता का आयोजन किया गया, जिसमें प्रतिभाशाली छात्रों ने अपनी गायन कला का प्रदर्शन किया। इसके साथ ही, रोटरी सहेली सेंटर के गरीब और वंचित छात्रों को उनके प्रयासों और कौशल विकास के लिए प्रमाण पत्र वितरित किए गए।
क्लब अध्यक्ष रोटेरियन जयप्रकाश अग्रवाल और वरिष्ठ रोटेरियन सदस्यों ने इस अवसर पर संदेश दिया कि वंचित महिलाओं और बच्चों को शिक्षा और कौशल विकास के अवसर प्रदान कर सामुदायिक सशक्तिकरण को मजबूत किया जा सकता है।
इस कार्यक्रम में प्रमुख रूप से उपस्थित Roterian सदस्यों में नारायण सिंघला, अर्जुन गुप्ता, अमित अग्रवाल, अमित सिंघला, अनुप्रिया अरोड़ा, रविंद्र सिंघला, मदन अग्रवाल, मनोज khera , अतुल गुप्ता, चंचल jeet singh, bina sibbal, vinita singhla, seema arora, bhupendar singh, और अन्य गणमान्य सदस्य शामिल रहे! 
यह कार्यक्रम रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर की सामुदायिक विकास और सदस्यों, अतिथियों, और स्थानीय समुदाय के बीच सहयोग को बढ़ावा देने की प्रतिबद्धता को दर्शाता है।

activities.title: रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर में महिला दिवस पर विशेष कार्यशाला का आयोजन
activities.description:
रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर में महिला दिवस पर विशेष कार्यशाला का आयोजन
रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर द्वारा महिला दिवस के अवसर पर एक विशेष कार्यशाला का आयोजन किया गया, जिसमें उषा कंपनी की सहायता से 70 से अधिक महिलाओं को एडवांस सिलाई-कटाई मशीनों का प्रशिक्षण प्रदान किया गया। इस कार्यक्रम में इनरव्हील क्लब के सदस्यों का भी महत्वपूर्ण योगदान रहा, जिन्होंने महिलाओं को सशक्त बनाने के इस प्रयास में पूरा सहयोग दिया।
कार्यक्रम में विभिन्न क्षेत्रों की प्रतिष्ठित महिलाएँ शामिल हुईं, जिनमें डॉ. यूकी अग्रवाल, ब्रिटानिया कंपनी की एचआर हेड मिस मुक्ता टंडन, सीएस निधि जैन, डायटीशियन रूबी सिंघला, शिक्षिका मिस सारिका, और इनरव्हील क्लब की अध्यक्ष मिस रंजीथा अग्रवाल प्रमुख थीं। क्लब द्वारा इन सभी अतिथियों का भव्य स्वागत किया गया।
कार्यक्रम की शुरुआत में एडवोकेट बबली अग्रवाल ने सभी विशिष्ट अतिथियों का फूलों के गुलदस्ते और उपहारों के साथ स्वागत किया। इस अवसर पर रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर के संस्थापक सदस्य ओम सिंघला, रमन सिब्बल, अशोक अग्रवाल एवं इनरव्हील क्लब के सदस्यगण भी उपस्थित रहे।
रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर के अध्यक्ष जयप्रकाश अग्रवाल ने अपने संबोधन में महिलाओं के सशक्तिकरण और कौशल विकास के महत्व पर प्रकाश डाला। उन्होंने कहा कि यह कार्यशाला महिलाओं को आत्मनिर्भर बनाने की दिशा में एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम है। क्लब भविष्य में भी इसी तरह के कार्यक्रमों का आयोजन करता रहेगा।
कार्यक्रम के दौरान उपस्थित महिलाओं ने कार्यशाला में रुचि दिखाते हुए आधुनिक सिलाई तकनीकों को सीखने की उत्सुकता जताई। इस अवसर पर क्लब द्वारा महिलाओं को प्रेरित करने और उनके उत्थान में योगदान देने का संकल्प लिया गया।
कार्यक्रम का समापन रोटरी क्लब और इनरव्हील क्लब के सदस्यों द्वारा धन्यवाद ज्ञापन के साथ हुआ।

activities.title: Diwali Milan Samaroh
activities.description:
रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर द्वारा दिवाली मिलन समारोह का भव्य आयोजन
रुद्रपुर, 27 अक्टूबर 2024 – रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर द्वारा रोटरी भवन में दिवाली मिलन समारोह का भव्य आयोजन संपन्न हुआ। क्लब अध्यक्ष रोटेरियन जयप्रकाश अग्रवाल के नेतृत्व में आयोजित इस कार्यक्रम में रोटरी परिवार के सदस्यों एवं उनके परिजनों ने उत्साहपूर्वक भाग लिया।
कार्यक्रम की शुरुआत शाम 7:00 बजे हुई, जिसमें स्वादिष्ट भोजन, मधुर संगीत, मनोरंजन और विशेष उपहारों ने सभी उपस्थितजनों का मन मोह लिया। कार्यक्रम में सभी सदस्यों ने मिलजुल कर दीपावली की शुभकामनाएँ दीं और आपसी सौहार्द का वातावरण बना रहा।
सभी सदस्यों ने रोटरी भवन परिसर में वाहन व्यवस्था में सहयोग कर कार्यक्रम को व्यवस्थित बनाए रखने में सहयोग दिया, जिसके लिए क्लब की ओर से आभार व्यक्त किया गया।
रोटरी क्लब रुद्रपुर समाज में भाईचारे और पारिवारिक भावना को मजबूत करने हेतु ऐसे आयोजन लगातार करता रहता है।

activities.title: Sports Meet For Intellectually Disabled Children
activities.description:
Rotary Club of Agra, organized a special sports competition, "Brave Hearts Inter-School Sports Meet," for intellectually disabled children. This unique initiative saw participation from 135 special children from seven institutions across the city, competing in 27 different sports events.
The event was inaugurated by Additional Police Commissioner of Agra Zone, Mr. Sanjeev Tyagi. Also present on the occasion were Rotary Club of Agra President Rotarian Namrata Panicker & Club Community Service Director Rotarian Umesh Gupta. Chief Guest Mr. Sanjeev Tyagi praised the initiative, stating that this was his first time attending such an event and that he was deeply moved by it. He extended congratulations to Rotary Club of Agra on behalf of the entire Agra Police Division for this commendable effort. The excitement and determination displayed by the children brought immense joy to their parents and spectators. All winners were awarded medals and certificates in recognition of their achievements.

activities.title: Inter-city Badminton Fellowship Meet
activities.description:
The Rotary Club of Agra successfully hosted the grand Intercity Badminton Championship today at Khelgaon Sports Club, Dayalbagh, Agra. The tournament saw participation from badminton players across various cities under Rotary District 3110. The event aimed to promote sports, foster camaraderie among Rotary members, and encourage sportsmanship.
The tournament was inaugurated by Sharat Chandra, DRFC & Past District Governor of Rotary International Zone 6. In his address, he stated, "Badminton is not just a sport but a discipline that strengthens dedication and teamwork. Such tournaments provide players with an excellent opportunity to showcase their talent and gain competitive experience." A total of 30 players from Agra, Aligarh, Kanpur, Mathura, and Bareilly participated in various categories.
✅ Men’s Doubles (Open):
Chandra Mohan & Shailendra Kumar (Aligarh) defeated Ashish Agrawal & Pankaj Dubey (Agra) 21-17, 21-14 to win the title.
✅ Men’s Singles (Open):
Sanjay Kalra (Agra) defeated Praveen Kumar (Mathura) 21-8, 21-11 to become the champion.
✅ Boys’ Singles (Open):
Siddharth Kalra (Agra) defeated Shivam Deepak (Agra) to claim the title.
✅ Boys’ Singles (Under 17):
Ekam (Agra) defeated Tanishk (Agra) to be crowned the winner.
✅ Men’s Doubles (50+):
Vikas Chandra Varshney & Shailendra Kumar (Aligarh) defeated Sanjay Kalra & Ashish Agrawal (Agra) to win the title.

activities.title: 87th Charter Night Celebration
activities.description:
Rotary Club of Agra celebrated its 87th Charter Anniversary with great enthusiasm and grandeur at Atul Farms, Dayalbagh. The occasion was graced by Rotary International District 3110 Governor, Rotarian Neerav Nimesh Agrawal, as the Chief Guest, and Rotary International Regional Coordinator, Rotarian Sharad Chandra, as the Guest of Honour.
In his address, Chief Guest Rotarian Neerav Nimesh Agrawal praised the glorious history of the Rotary Club of Agra and commended President Rotarian Namrata Panicker for leading the club to new heights. Special Guest Rotarian Sharad Chandra also lauded the club’s consistent efforts in community service, calling it an exemplary model for other organizations.
Club President Namrata Panicker congratulated all members on the occasion and expressed her gratitude for the unwavering support of every member, which continuously inspires her to serve society.
Club Secretary Rotarian Engineer Ashish Agrawal presented the club's report, highlighting that 142 activities have been successfully executed in the past 277 days, setting a remarkable record. He assured that the club would continue its momentum with even greater energy in the remaining 93 days.
The celebration featured vibrant cultural performances, with members participating enthusiastically. On this occasion, the club honored its 15 senior-most members for their continues contributions towards the club’s success.

activities.title: Puppet Show For Special Children
activities.description:
Embracing this spirit, the Rotary Club of Agra organized a vibrant puppet show at St. Alphonso Institute, a school for intellectually challenged children.
The event was specially curated to bring joy and laughter to the children. The puppets performed to entertaining tunes including the iconic Naagin dance, songs of Shah Rukh Khan, and the beloved folk tune Lakdi ki kaathi, kaathi pe ghoda, leaving the children laughing heartily and filling the atmosphere with cheer and excitement.
The program began with a soulful prayer dance and welcome song performed by the students of the institute. On this occasion, Club President Rtn. Namrata Panicker expressed her heartfelt gratitude to Sister Alpho Mathew, the Principal of the institution, and the dedicated teachers for giving the Rotary Club the opportunity to bring smiles to the faces of these special children. She assured that the club would continue supporting the holistic development and bright future of these children in every possible way.
Sister Alpho Mathew also appreciated the club’s initiative, mentioning that not only the children but their parents were equally delighted and excited upon hearing about the event.
Former Club President Rtn. Rajesh Jain, Director Rtn. Sunil Kapoor, Rtn. Ira Sharma, and Rtn. Manoj R. Kumar were also present on this special occasion.

activities.title: Free Health Check UP Camp
activities.description:
On the occasion of World Health Day, the Rotary Club of Agra, in collaboration with the Agra Cantt Pre-Paid Auto Taxi Drivers’ Union and the Atal Chowk Seva Samiti, organized a large-scale free health check-up camp at the Railway Institute, Agra Cantt Railway Station. The camp was inaugurated by the Chief Guest, Mr. Sanat Jain, Senior Divisional Personnel Officer, North Central Railways.
Rotary Club of Agra President, Rotarian Namrata Panicker, stated that the club is deeply committed to community service in the fields of health, education, and the environment, and continues to undertake initiatives within its capacity during her tenure. This health camp was yet another step in that direction.
The camp provided specialist consultations in general medicine, gynecology, and ophthalmology. Ward 36 councilor from Mustafa Quarters, Mr. Rakesh Kannaujia, welcomed all Rotary officials and doctors by presenting them with garlands. Atal Chowk Seva Samiti President, Mr. D.P. Rathore, informed that free blood pressure and blood sugar tests were also conducted during the camp.
Mr. Anil Sharma, General Secretary of the Pre-Paid Auto Taxi Drivers’ Union, shared that the Rotary Club distributed free spectacles to nearly 200 patients with vision issues.
Ophthalmologist Dr. Rahul Singh noted that excessive mobile phone use is contributing to a rise in eye-related problems, particularly weakening of eyesight. General Physician Dr. Shiv Kumar Sharma observed that most patients suffered from illnesses linked to deteriorating lifestyle habits. Gynecologist Dr. Geeta Agarwal expressed concern over women neglecting their own health while being preoccupied with family responsibilities, often seeking medical help only when the condition becomes serious.
Generic medicines including multivitamins, calcium, iron supplements, and eye drops were distributed free of cost to patients. Around 250 individuals benefited from the health services provided at the camp.

activities.title: Puppet Show For Special Children
activities.description:
Rotary Club of Agra is celebrating this year as the "Feel Good Year," with a mission to spread happiness across all sections of society. Staying true to this vision, the club organized a vibrant puppet show for the students of Asha School, an institution run by the Army Wives Welfare Association (AWWA) for intellectually special children.
The event was filled with laughter and excitement as the puppets performed lively dances, including the Nagin dance, Michael Jackson’s iconic breakdance moves, and a playful act on the popular folk song "Lakdi ki Kaathi." The children were thoroughly entertained, their giggles and cheers filling the air with joy.
The program began with a warm welcome by the school principal, Mrs. Aditi Paresh, and the teaching staff. Rotary Club President Rotarian Namrata Panicker expressed gratitude to the principal and dedicated teachers for giving the club the opportunity to be part of the children’s happiness. She assured continued support from Rotary Club Agra for the bright future of these special children.
Mrs. Aditi Paresh praised the club’s efforts, stating, "Rotary Club of Agra is truly working with a unique vision for these children." As a token of appreciation, the school gifted the club members hand-painted artworks made by the students.
Prominent attendees included Club Secretary Rotarian Er. Ashish Agarwal, Vice President Rotarian Jitendra Jain, Rotarian Shailendra Nath Sharma, Rotarian Shalini Agarwal, Rotarian Srishti Jain, and Rotarian Manoj R. Kumar.

activities.title: Rotary Junior Ambassador Contest
activities.description:
Rotary Club of Agra organized the "Rotary Junior Ambassador Contest" today at Shivalik Public School, located on Bichpuri Road, for students of classes 9 to 12. Through this contest, students were introduced to the various social and humanitarian service programs run by Rotary International across the globe.
The event began with Club President Rotarian Namrata Panicker addressing the students. She encouraged them to become a part of Rotary and contribute towards society and the nation. Citing the example of Swedish environmental activist Greta Thunberg, she said that Greta was also an ordinary student like them, but her initiative for environmental conservation brought her international recognition. Namrata urged the students to raise their voices against anything wrong they witness in society.
Past President Rotarian Dr. Alok Mittal introduced the students to the Four-Way Test of Rotary and highlighted the significant role Rotary has played in combating global diseases like polio.
Rotarian Manoj R. Kumar engaged the students in a discussion about the major issues they observe in society and how they can contribute to resolving them. Students actively participated and presented their thoughts with conviction.
Based on the strength of their responses and presentations, Niti Gahnar, a student of class 9, was declared the "Rotary Junior Ambassador".

activities.title: Eye & Dental Check-up Camp
activities.description:
Rotary Club of Agra organized a free dental and eye check-up camp today for students of primary and junior classes at Shivalik Public School, located on Bichpuri Road. On this occasion, the school principal, Mrs. Vandana Shukla, warmly welcomed the members of the Rotary Club and the attending doctors.
During the camp, dental specialist Dr. Vipul Arora and his team examined the dental health of approximately 300 students from the primary section. Dr. Arora also shared simple and effective tips with the children on maintaining oral hygiene. Meanwhile, eye specialist Dr. Kaustubh Sane conducted eye check-ups for around 250 students from the junior section and advised them to limit their screen time on mobile phones and televisions.
The camp was coordinated by Rotarian Dr. Alok Mittal. Club President Rotarian Namrata Panicker informed that the Rotary Club of Agra places special emphasis on the health and education of children. This medical camp was organized under the ‘Aarogyam’ initiative run by Rotary International District 3110.

activities.title: Vision 360- Career & Courage
activities.description:
यूनाइटेड पब्लिक स्कूल में रोटरी क्लब कानपुर वेस्ट के तत्वावधान में इंटरैक्ट क्लब ऑफ़ यूनाइटेड पब्लिक स्कूल के साथ एक अनोखी और प्रेरणादायक कार्यशाला “विज़न ३६०- करियर और करेज” का आयोजन किया गया। इस अवसर पर करियर काउंसलर व मोटिवेशनल स्पीकर अपने क्लब के सदस्य रोटेरियन अरुणेंद्र सोनी ने विद्यार्थियों से संवाद किया और उन्हें यह समझाया कि करियर केवल अंकों या स्ट्रीम तक सीमित नहीं होता, बल्कि यह रुचियों, क्षमताओं, जीवन-मूल्यों और भविष्य की ज़रूरतों को समझ कर चुना जाना चाहिए।

मानसिक संतुलन, भावनात्मक बुद्धिमत्ता और एकाग्रता जैसे विषयों पर कंसल्टेंट साइकेट्रिस्ट रोटेरियन डॉ. रोहन कुमार ने विद्यार्थियों को जीवन के तनावों से निपटने के व्यावहारिक उपाय बताए और माइंड-बॉडी कनेक्शन की महत्ता को सरल भाषा में समझाया।
विद्यार्थियों ने खुलकर सवाल पूछे और विशेषज्ञों से सहज व स्पष्ट उत्तर प्राप्त किए, जिससे उन्हें न सिर्फ आत्म-विश्वास मिला बल्कि भविष्य की ओर सोचने का एक नया नजरिया भी।

इस विशेष सत्र में वरिष्ठ रोटेरियन और क्लब मेंटर रोटेरियन ओ.पी. अग्रवाल ने भी अपनी गरिमामयी उपस्थिति से विद्यार्थियों को प्रेरित किया। साथ ही प्रिंसिपल श्रीमती ज्योति दास,स्टूडेंट कोऑर्डिनेटर श्रीमती सुप्रिया सिन्हा,रोटेरियन प्रदीप नेमानी, रोटेरियन सूरज जयसवाल और एन रजनी झावर ने भी विद्यार्थियों से संवाद कर उन्हें जीवन में उद्देश्य व जुनून के साथ आगे बढ़ने की प्रेरणा दी।

activities.title: RI Foundation Giving Program @ Agra
activities.description:
On March 6, 2025, Rotary Club Aligarh participated in the prestigious Foundation of Hope: Celebrating Service – TRF Seminar in Agra, marking an incredible milestone in our journey of service and commitment. With 14 awards won across various categories, our club demonstrated exceptional dedication to Rotary’s mission of humanitarian impact and excellence.

Honoring excellence, Rotary Club Aligarh secured:

4 Awards (2 President + 2 Secretary) in the Global Grants category, recognizing our contributions in 2022-23 & 2024-25.
3 Awards in the Major Donors category, celebrating the generosity of Rtn. Rajiv Mittal, Rtn. Rajeev Agarwal, and Rtn. Dr. Amit Gupta.
1 Award for being a 100% Foundation Giving Club (2024-25), reinforcing our commitment to giving back.
6 Awards in the Major Contribution category, acknowledging outstanding donors whose contributions ranged from USD 1,000 to USD 10,000.

This momentous occasion was graced by RI Foundation Director Rtn. Bharat Pandya and TRF Trustee Chair Mark Maloney, along with his wife from the USA, adding prestige to the celebration.

RC Aligarh is immensely proud to receive these recognitions, standing as a beacon of service, philanthropy, and leadership within the Rotary fraternity. As we move forward, we remain committed to upholding Rotary’s values and making a lasting impact on the community.

activities.title: Rotary 14th Cricket Tournament 2025
activities.description:
Rotary Club Aligarh proudly participated in the 14th Rotary Cricket Tournament, organized by Rotary Club Aligarh City. The tournament brought together 8 teams from various Rotary Clubs, fostering sportsmanship, fellowship, and teamwork.

Tournament Highlights:
The event saw enthusiastic participation from Rotarians and Annets, showcasing exceptional cricketing skills and spirit. After a series of exciting matches, Rotary Club Aligarh reached the finals, facing Rotary Club Smart City in a highly anticipated showdown. Demonstrating outstanding batting, bowling, and teamwork, our team secured a remarkable victory by 8 wickets, claiming the championship title.

Impact & Achievements:
This triumph reinforced Rotary Club Aligarh’s commitment to teamwork, leadership, and fellowship beyond service projects. The tournament served as a platform for strengthening relationships among Rotarians, fostering unity and collaboration. It highlighted the importance of sports in bringing communities together, promoting fitness and engagement.

Conclusion:
The 14th Rotary Cricket Tournament was an unforgettable experience, celebrating sportsmanship and camaraderie among Rotary Clubs. Rotary Club Aligarh’s victory in the final match stands as a moment of pride and achievement, inspiring more such collaborative events in the future.

activities.title: Holi Milan
activities.description:
Rotary Club Aligarh successfully organized a grand Holi Milan program, bringing together members and their families for a celebration of tradition, festivity, and fellowship. The event was highlighted by the unique Phoolon Ki Holi, where vibrant flowers replaced traditional colors, creating a beautiful and spiritual ambiance. Adding to the festive spirit, attendees enjoyed the delicious Mathura-style chaat, which brought the authentic flavors of this historic city to the gathering. The evening was further enriched by a mesmerizing Radha-Krishna cultural performance by a talented troupe from Mathura, captivating the audience with devotional music and dance.

The program saw an impressive turnout, with 164 Rotarians and their families joining the celebration, making it a memorable and joyous occasion. The event provided an excellent opportunity for members to strengthen their bonds, exchange festive greetings, and embrace the spirit of Holi with warmth and camaraderie. It successfully reinforced Rotary's values of unity, service, and cultural appreciation while bringing the community together in an atmosphere of joy and fellowship.

activities.title: Board Of Directors Meeting
activities.description:
Rotary Club Aligarh successfully hosted its Board of Directors Meeting on March 27, 2025, at Dawn to Dusk, Hotel Melrose In, Marris Road, Aligarh. 

The meeting commenced with the:
1. Confirmation of minutes from the previous Board meeting, ensuring continuity and transparency in club operations.
2. A key highlight was the discussion and finalization of four new members inducted this month, further strengthening the club’s network and outreach. 
3. Members also deliberated on the upcoming awareness project on cervical cancer, emphasizing the club’s commitment to health and education initiatives. 
4. Another major agenda item was the construction of a platform at RGS Junior High School, Pala Road, Aligarh, aimed at improving infrastructure and supporting student learning.
5. Looking ahead, plans for a Karaoke Dinner Night next month were discussed, reinforcing fellowship and camaraderie among members. 
6. Additional matters were addressed with the permission of the chair, ensuring an inclusive and productive discussion.

The evening concluded with a delightful fellowship dinner, generously hosted by Rtn. Kamal Mittal, Rtn. Bharat Uppal, and Rtn. Shashank Agarwal, providing an opportunity for members to bond over good food and conversation.

The Board meeting was highly productive, reinforcing Rotary Club Aligarh’s mission of service, leadership, and fellowship, setting the foundation for future impactful initiatives.

activities.title: Webinar 2 - On Global Grant No. Gg2575271
activities.description: Rotary Club Aligarh hosted a pivotal discussion on its Global Grant Project, “Advanced Vitreo Retinal Ophthalmic Complex & Research Centre.” The meeting was attended by District Governor Rtn. Neerav Nimesh Agarwal Ji, Rtn. Ashutosh Ji, EDS, Senior Rtn. Madhup Lehri, Counsellor Rtn. Suresh Govil Ji, DGND Rtn. Rajiv Mittal Ji, DG Rtn. Divakar Varshney Ji, Rtn. Rajeev Agarwal Anu Ji, Club President Rtn. Rajeev Agarwal, Secretary Rtn. Devesh Gupta, Rtn. Shashank Agarwal, Rtn. Dr. Amit Gupta. The dignitaries evaluated project objectives, funding strategies, and implementation approaches, aiming to provide advanced ophthalmic care and research facilities. The meeting emphasized community outreach, medical advancements, and collaborative efforts to ensure the success of the initiative.

activities.title: Phuket & Karabi - International Conference
activities.description:
Rotary Club Mathura Central successfully organized a prestigious international conference in Phuket & Krabi, Thailand, offering an enriching platform for learning, networking, and fellowship. This six-day event provided attendees with valuable discussions, cultural exchanges, and memorable experiences, strengthening global Rotary connections.

A delegation of total more than 50 Rotarians across district 3110 & 7 Rotarians from Rotary Club Aligarh, accompanied by their families, actively participated in the conference. The event featured informative sessions, leadership discussions, and strategic planning, fostering engagement and knowledge-sharing among Rotarians. Participants enjoyed the beautiful landscapes of Phuket & Krabi, balancing professional development with cultural exploration and relaxation.

The conference facilitated cross-club interactions, further enhancing collaboration and strengthening relationships within the Rotary community. Created lasting memories, reinforcing the importance of service beyond borders and fostering global connections.

The International Conference in Phuket & Krabi was a resounding success, providing Rotarians from Aligarh with an exceptional learning experience and an opportunity to bond with fellow members across clubs. Rotary Club Aligarh remains committed to participating in such global events, ensuring continued growth, fellowship, and service-driven impact.

activities.title: Close Meeting
activities.description:
Rotary Club Aligarh conducted a Closed Meeting at Aligarh Club on April 10, 2025, focusing on the confirmation of accounts for Rotary Year 2023-24. This vital discussion ensured transparency, accountability, and financial clarity within the club.

Discussion & Highlights:
The financial accounts of RY 2023-24 were presented for confirmation, led by Rtn. Ram Bansal (President), Rtn. Dr. Bharat Varshney (Secretary), and Rtn. Atul Agarwal (Treasurer). The meeting saw cross-questioning and deliberations, ensuring thorough scrutiny and understanding of the financial records. Old PST members provided clarifications, addressing concerns and ensuring unanimous approval of the accounts. The meeting concluded successfully, reaffirming trust, financial integrity, and accountability within the club.

Fellowship Dinner & Member Engagement:
Following the formal discussions, 128 members enjoyed a fellowship dinner, celebrating unity and camaraderie among Rotarians. The gathering reinforced the importance of collaboration and strengthened the bonds within the club.

activities.title: Pet Set - Learning Seminar (agra Zone)
activities.description:
Rotary Club Aligarh Icon successfully hosted the PET SET – Learning Seminar on March 9, 2025, bringing together presidents-elect and secretaries-elect from over 40 Rotary Clubs in the Agra Zone. The seminar aimed to equip new leadership teams with the knowledge, skills, and strategies required for an effective Rotary Year.

District Governor Elect 2025-26 Rtn. Rajan Vidhyarthi led key discussions, emphasizing Rotary’s goals for the upcoming year. Interactive training sessions focused on leadership development, project planning, and club administration.

Rotary Club Aligarh proudly participated with six members actively engaging in learning and collaboration. The seminar concluded with a networking lunch, providing an opportunity for fellowship and interaction among Rotarians.

New Leadership Team – Rotary Club Aligarh:
Following the seminar, the new leadership team for Rotary Club Aligarh for RY 2025-26 was announced:

President: Rtn. Pramod Gupta
Secretary: Rtn. Devesh Gupta
Treasurer: Rtn. Gaurav Mittal

The PET SET – Learning Seminar was a valuable platform for learning and leadership development, preparing Rotary leaders for a successful and productive year ahead. Rotary Club Aligarh looks forward to implementing the insights gained and driving impactful initiatives in the upcoming Rotary Year.

activities.title: Science Of Happiness
activities.description:
In a thought-provoking Happiness Workshop organized by the Rotary Club of Agra at Hotel Bhawna Clarks Inn, renowned senior psychiatrist Dr. Vishal Sinha guided club members through the science and psychology of staying happy, even amidst life’s challenges. His insightful and engaging session inspired the audience to explore a fresh perspective on emotional well-being and balance.
Dr. Sinha explained that our brain is naturally wired to perceive situations with a negative bias – a survival mechanism designed to prepare us mentally for challenges. However, this tendency often works against our emotional health. He emphasized that by changing our thought patterns and embracing positivity, we can significantly improve our mental health and overall quality of life.
He also highlighted that women tend to have greater multitasking abilities and emotional intelligence compared to men. Stressing the importance of communication, he shared that many mental stresses can be resolved simply through open conversation. Addressing parents specifically, he advised them to actively listen to their children when they return from school, as dismissing their stories can lead to a long-term habit of emotional withdrawal.
“Happiness requires more than just a smile – it needs meaningful communication and mutual understanding,” said Dr. Sinha, encapsulating the essence of the session.
Rotary Club of Agra President Rtn. Namrata Panicker remarked, “We often focus on how to keep ourselves happy, but true fulfillment comes when we can spread that happiness to those around us without compromising our own joy. This workshop was designed to inspire exactly that.”
Club Secretary Rtn. Er. Ashish Agrawal and Rtn. Rajeev Lochan Bhardwaj engaged Dr. Sinha in an interactive discussion on how to remain composed during difficult situations and when it is appropriate to seek professional mental health advice.

activities.title: Gau Seva - Donation Of Rs. 3.85 Lacs
activities.description:
Continuing its annual tradition, the Rotary Club of Agra extended financial support of Rs. 3.85 lakh this year as well to the SPCA Gaushala located in Dayalbagh. This amount has been donated for the care and feeding of the destitute cattle sheltered at the gaushala. The funds were raised by club members for this noble cause of gau seva (cow service).
The program commenced with the ceremonial lighting of the lamp by Rotary District Governor Rtn. Neerav Nimesh Agrawal. Deeply moved by the dedicated cow service being carried out at the shelter, he announced a personal contribution of Rs. 21,000 for the same cause. He highlighted that cow’s milk is highly nutritious, while cow urine and dung possess medicinal properties, beneficial for organic farming, environmental protection, and energy production. From a religious perspective, the cow is revered as ‘Mother’, believed to embody 33 crore deities and holds immense significance in rituals, prayers, and festivals.
Club President Rtn. Namrata Panicker remarked that the cow is not merely an animal, but an integral part of our culture, faith, health, and economy. With proper care and protection, cows can be a true blessing for both humanity and the environment. She extended her appreciation and congratulations to the Gaushala management for their commendable work.
The program concluded with a vote of thanks delivered by Past President Rtn. Rajesh Jain. On this occasion, several distinguished members were present, including District Secretary Rtn. Ashutosh Kumar and club members Rtn. Ram Saran Mittal, Rtn. Surendra Kumar Jain, Rtn. Shanti Swaroop Goyal, Rtn. Vivek Mohan Agrawal, Rtn. Vinod Gupta, Rtn. Vishnu Saran Mehra, Rtn. Mukesh Chaturvedi, Rtn. Deen Dayal Agrawal, Rtn. Udit Bansal, Rtn. Toolika Bansal, and Rtn. Manoj R. Kumar.

activities.title: Word Earth Day - Bicycle Expedition & Plantation
activities.description:
On April 22nd, to mark the 55th Earth Day, the Rotary Club of Agra organized a cycle and foot march to spread the message of “Go Green.” This year’s Earth Day theme was “Our Power, Our Earth.” The march started from Lopamudra Vidya Mandir, Shilpgram and proceeded to Dussehra Ghat. Alongside the members of the Rotary Club of Agra, students from the Interact Club of The International School also participated with great enthusiasm.
On this occasion, Club President Rotarian Namrata Panicker stated that protecting the Earth is not the responsibility of just one generation — it is a collective duty to ensure we pass on a clean, safe, and prosperous planet to future generations. She emphasized the importance of environmental conservation, the proper use of natural resources, and addressing the challenges of climate change.
Principal of The International School, Mr. Abhay Mathur, encouraged the youth, saying that continuous efforts are needed in areas such as deforestation prevention, pollution control, population control, and adopting eco-friendly lifestyles. He also highlighted the importance of recycling and reusing.
After the march, all participants planted trees within the premises of Lopamudra Vidya Mandir and took a pledge to keep the Earth green and thriving.

activities.title: Free Eye Test Camp
activities.description:
Under the Aarogyam initiative of Rotary District 3110, the Rotary Club of Agra organized a free eye check-up camp today at Sacred Mother Junior School, located in Kamla Nagar. The camp was conducted under the supervision of renowned ophthalmologist Dr. Rahul Singh.
During the camp, Dr. Singh’s team carried out preliminary eye screenings for around 350 students. Children identified with vision-related issues were provided with free consultations by Dr. Singh himself. He advised students to minimize mobile phone usage and, if necessary, opt for larger screens like LED TVs. According to Dr. Singh, prolonged exposure to small screens increases strain on the eyes, and their intense brightness can cause damage.
Rotarian Namrata Panicker, President of Rotary Club of Agra, stated that the club is continuously working to promote health and education across various schools in the city. Aarogyam is part of this ongoing initiative, aimed at raising health awareness among students from classes 1 to 8 and providing essential preliminary health services.
Key contributions to the success of this event were made by Rotarian Tulika Bansal, Rotarian Shailendra Nath Sharma, Rotarian Sunil Kapoor, Rotarian Udit Bansal, and Rotarian Manoj R. Kumar. The school principal, Mrs. Kritika Tahilyani, expressed her heartfelt gratitude to all members of the Rotary Club of Agra.

activities.title: Workshop - Safe & Unsafe Touch
activities.description:
Rotary Club Agra has launched an important campaign to educate school children about "safe and unsafe touch." Under this initiative, the club is organizing awareness workshops in various schools to make children aware of their personal safety and empower them for self-protection.
Namrata Panikar, President of Rotary Club Agra, said, "Teaching children to recognize inappropriate behavior and encouraging them to stay safe is a necessity today. This topic should be included in the school curriculum." With this objective, the club has started a series of special workshops to prevent child sexual abuse.
15th Workshop Held at Holy Public Junior College
As part of this effort, the club organized its 15th workshop at Holy Public Junior College in Awas Vikas. Over 400 children from classes 3 to 8 participated in the program. Legal expert and Rotarian Namrata Mishra explained the difference between "safe and unsafe touch" to the children through stories and real-life examples. She also taught them practical ways to handle uncomfortable situations.
Information Shared on Digital Safety
Additionally, Namrata Mishra alerted the children about the growing dangers in the digital age. She explained how cybercriminals try to exploit children through social media and advised them against sharing personal information online. She also shared tips on online safety.
Principal Expresses Gratitude

The event was supported by Rotarians Shailendra Nath Sharma, Shalini Agrawal, C.S. Tulika Bansal, Engr. Ashish Agrawal, C.A. Udit Bansal, and Manoj R. Kumar.

activities.title: Seminar - Mastering The Money Game
activities.description:
In an enlightening initiative aimed at promoting financial literacy and independence, the Rotary Club of Agra organized a seminar titled “Mastering the Money Game – Tools and Tactics for Financial Freedom” at the prestigious Hotel Clarks Shiraz. The seminar, attended by enthusiastic members of the club, featured renowned Chartered Accountant Shri Rakesh Agarwal as the keynote speaker.
With decades of expertise in financial planning and tax consultancy, CA Rakesh Agarwal captivated the audience by breaking down complex financial concepts into practical tools and strategies. Using real-world examples, he emphasized the importance of diversified investment and financial discipline. Highlighting the cases of prominent industrialists like Anil Ambani and Vijay Mallya, he pointed out how poor financial planning can lead to catastrophic failures, regardless of business size or legacy. “Money should never be our master; it must be our servant, always working for us,” he said.
The seminar also addressed a range of pertinent issues raised by attendees, especially around tax-saving strategies under varying financial conditions. Members actively engaged in the discussion, seeking clarity on the new tax policies introduced by the government and how they impact individual and family financial planning.
Club President Rtn. Namrata Panicker, in her address, underlined the need for financial awareness among all family members. “While traditionally, men have managed household finances, it is equally important for women to understand and participate in wealth creation and money management. This seminar has served as a timely platform to equip our members with the knowledge they need,” she remarked.
CA Agarwal strongly advised against putting all investments in a single avenue, urging members to diversify across different financial instruments to mitigate risk and ensure long-term stability.
The seminar began with a warm welcome extended to the chief guest by Senior Rotarian Rtn. Rakesh Garg & Rtn. SK Jain. As a token of gratitude, Rtn. CS Gupta presented a memento to the keynote speaker on behalf of the club. The event concluded with a heartfelt vote of thanks by Rtn. Digamber Singh Dhakrey, appreciating the efforts of all involved in making the event a success.
Key contributors to the seamless organization of the seminar included Club Secretary Rtn. Er. Ashish Agarwal, Treasurer Rtn. CA Udit Bansal, Club Trainer Rtn. Rajeev Lochan Bhardwaj, and Rtn. Sunil Kapoor.

activities.title: Seminar - Leadership
activities.description:
In a thought-provoking seminar that blended wisdom, experience, and vision, the Rotary Club of Agra organized an impactful Leadership Seminar at Hotel Holiday Inn, Agra. The event brought together eminent thought leaders, Rotarians, and distinguished guests from various Rotary Clubs across the city, all converging to reflect upon the essence and evolution of true leadership.
The seminar commenced with the auspicious Lighting of the Lamp ceremony, graced by the keynote speakers Prof. (Dr.) Jayanthi Ranjan, Vice Chancellor of Sharda University, Agra, and Tilakyat Shri Mahant Yogesh Puri of Shri Mankameshwar Math, Agra, along other senior members of the Club.
In her welcome address, Rtn. Namrata Panicker, President of Rotary Club of Agra, emphasized that Rotary is not merely a service organization but a nurturing ground for leadership. “Rotary instills in individuals the power to lead with compassion and service. Today’s seminar is an exploration of leadership through the lenses of spirituality and education,” she remarked.
Tilakyat Shri Mahant Yogesh Puri, in his compelling address on spiritual leadership, underlined the foundational role of knowledge. “True leadership is rooted in awareness and understanding. India’s vast spiritual and intellectual heritage gives us a unique strength. We must take pride in our divine lineage—not as descendants of apes, but as progeny of the creators of the cosmos,” he stated, urging the audience to reconnect with the wisdom of ancient scriptures.
Prof. (Dr.) Jayanthi Ranjan, delivering her keynote on educational leadership, echoed the sentiment that leaders are made, not born. “Leadership is the art of empowering those around you. Institutions like Rotary Club of Agra are silently shaping change makers by fostering a spirit of service and self-growth. Education remains our most powerful catalyst for societal transformation,” she said. Dr. Ranjan also highlighted the invaluable lessons embedded in India’s ancient epics, urging all to revisit them for guidance and inspiration.
The seminar captivated the audience, who were visibly moved by the depth and clarity of thought shared by both distinguished speakers. A formal Vote of Thanks was delivered by Rtn. Dr. Mukesh Goyal, appreciating the speakers and the organizing team for their invaluable contributions.
The program was efficiently coordinated and anchored by Rtn. Tulika Bansal, with the support of an enthusiastic team comprising Rtn. Sachin, Agarwal, Er. Kiran Gupta, Rtn. Er. Ashish Agarwal, Rtn. Udit Bansal, Rtn. Jitendra Jain, Rtn. K.D. Gupta, Rtn. Rajeev Lochan Bhardwaj, Rtn. Sangita Agarwal and Rtn. Srishti Jain, among others, who played a pivotal role in making the event a grand success.

activities.title: DIABETES CLINIC.. Permanent Community Service Program.. Every Saturday
activities.description:
DIABETES CLINIC- Permanent Community Service project

A feather in the cap of Rotary Club of Kanpur Greater, our weekly conducted Diabetes clinic is running smoothly every Saturday morning from 8.00 Am to 10.30 Am.
Besides vitals being checked, sugar tested, patients getting individual consultation from our dedicated Dr. Yagnik and medicines dispensed free of cost. I wish to bring to light few highlights from this programme. In spite of being a charitable programme, the patients have access to an air-conditioned waiting hall, clean washrooms, and drinking water dispenser with disposable glasses made available to them every Saturday morning by the Regency Hospital staff. So far we have treated around 16000 patients.
While waiting for their turns the patients are educated on the role of diet, exercises, Yoga and good mental health in Diabetes control.
Some exciting new developments in recent times are
1. Rt. Vikas Arora, Ann Sangeeta Garg & First Lady Ann Karisma Paraswani have joined team Diabetes
2. Free investigations for needy patients are being done courtesy Dr. Atul Kapoor & Regency Hospital

activities.title: Langar Sewa- Ongoing Community Service Project
activities.description:
LANGAR SEVA- Permanent Community Service Project


Langar Sewa is not just about feeding people—it’s a living example of love in action, and a timeless reminder that true spirituality lies in serving humanity. A true Rotary Legacy


Langar Sewa , our ongoing community service project at Hallet Hospital has over the years got unstinted support & patronage from our fellow Rotarians
Needless to say, feeding the poor & underprivileged is the best form of Sewa.
Langar is prepared at the Gurudwara followed by Ardaas for the peace & well being & tranquility of the beneficiary. The food served becomes Prasad with divine blessings.
The Sewa is done voluntarily by the members without any financial burden on the club.


What began as a gesture of compassion has blossomed into a meaningful tradition of unity, dignity, and care. 
Our members came forward for Langar Sewa, to spread the Magic of Rotary on their special occasions by “Spreading Smiles “ in the lives of the underprivileged, we’ve not only served meals, we’ve served hope, respect, and love to those who need it most. 
This year we organized around 125 Langar serving to more than 30000 people.

Our Director Community service , Rtn Kanwar Prit Singh Saluja is heading this project by the support of our members.

activities.title: RCKG’s Mission to Empower Children with Disabilities
activities.description:
RCKG’s Mission to Empower Children with Disabilities

At Rotary Club of Kanpur Greater, we are deeply committed to supporting children with disabilities—particularly those who are deaf, mute, blind, or mentally challenged. Our efforts aim not only to assist them with immediate needs but also to pave the way for long-term growth, independence, and inclusion.

Focus on Deaf and Mute Children
Our primary focus is on children with profound hearing loss, including those with cochlear implants. While the government has commendably supported cochlear implant surgeries for children from underprivileged families (costing approx. ₹5 lakhs), a critical gap remains: the high cost of post-surgery accessories and therapies.

Our Impact:

We have supported 275+ children from economically weaker sections by providing essential cochlear implant accessories.
We fund online therapy sessions for children who cannot attend in person, ensuring continued developmental support.
Early Detection Initiative:
Recognizing the vital importance of early intervention, we’ve collaborated with the Deputy CMO of Kanpur to implement OAE (Otoacoustic Emission) tests within 72 hours of birth in government hospitals. When necessary, we facilitate BERA (Brainstem Evoked Response Audiometry) testing to confirm diagnoses—laying the groundwork for early treatment and better outcomes. This initiative is currently in progress and nearing implementation.

Therapy Access:
Therapies are essential for cochlear implants to be truly effective. We are working to compile and distribute therapy modules to guardians, free of cost, to ensure every child receives consistent support at home.

Support for Blind Children
We extend continuous support to visually impaired children by:

Funding a dedicated computer teacher and music classes.
Assisting with transportation logistics for children commuting to school, ensuring education remains accessible.
Support for Mentally Challenged Children
Many therapies for mentally challenged children require long-term involvement and personalized support. Our members actively:

Fund therapies as needed.
Offer personalized assistance and hand-holding to both children and families throughout their journey.
Vocational and Financial Independence
We also emphasize long-term empowerment by providing vocational support to:

Parents of disabled children wishing to start a small business.
Older children seeking skills for financial independence.

This initiative is driven entirely by the passion and commitment of our members and single handedly taken care by our Director for Specially abled , Rtn Vijay Parikh and we are proud of the difference we've made—and will continue to make—with your support.

activities.title: Free Insulin Distribution
activities.description:
The tone of the Rotary year 24-25 was set by the launching of the ambitious free insulin distribution to the underprivileged patients from 1st July 24 in our diabetic clinic at Regency City Center, PPN Market.
Since its inception about a decade back, the RCKG diabetic clinic has now grown to be a compressive control program taking care of all aspects of diabetes management – investigation, consultation, medicine distribution, dietary control and lifestyle counselling and now the last step – free insulin distribution has been added. So far we have treated around 16000 patients so far. The free insulin distribution was started from 5th October 24 and 22 patients are now been provided in the last 8 months. The club is providing insulin as well as pen and monitor through a medical representative. 
My team is lucky that we have a man who always played a pivotal role to guide, educate and add new dimensions from time to time. He was none other than the founder of this project Rtn Dr. Pankaj Tandon. I personally thank all the donors who are contributing funds for these insulin patients without boarding financial stress on our club. 
Another feather was added when our Ann Dr Madhu Tandon joined the clinic on July 23 with an entirely new concept. Apart from normal clinical activities, she started counselling with diabetic after effects on women as well as educating these patients for their eating habits, lifestyle and to overcome stress. Dr Deepak Yagnik also joined and educate these patients for precautions required with age and time.
Our team was once again thrilled when our fellow Rtn. Vikas Arora, Ann Sangeeta Garg and First Lady Ann Karishma Paraswani joined us on May 24. In my opinion a very few NGOs work & conduct in such a way in health related services.
Last but not the least I thank my Board as well as the last 9 Boards who bestow faith upon me. On behalf of my board and club I thank Dr Deepak Yagnik for selfless and dedicated services rendered to us.

Our gratitude goes to Rtn Dr. Atul Kapoor and Ann Dr. Rashmi Kapoor

for providing an excellent team from Regency Health Care, ensuring

smooth and efficient management. They exemplify selfless service.

This project will significantly benefit many children.

Asst. Dist. Governor Ann Sunanda Karwa graced the occasion, praising

the project's well-planned execution.

activities.title: Navratri Community Service Week
activities.description: Navratri is a beautiful time of the year. It is a reminder to embrace the spiritual light, conquer our fears and celebrate the divine feminine energy. At RCKG we celebrated Navratri by observing a 7 day Navratri community service week. 'Spreading smiles' being the theme of the year we decided to dedicate these 7 days of spirituality towards bringing joy and happiness to lesser privileged section of the society. on 9 consecutive days our members donated essentials to the needy at 9 different locations. We started this week with the Rotary drive of blood donation.

activities.title: Park Renovation And Installation Of Water Cooler, Open Gym And Swings
activities.description:
On 7th April 2025, a much anticipated dream turned into reality with the successful development and inauguration of the lush green RCKG SOMVATIKA in Civil Lines, near Tulsi Hospital.

The renovated park now features newly installed swings for children, an open gym and a water cooler, offering both fun and comfort to the community. The beautification of the park has been nothing short of remarkable, and the visitors have expressed immense appreciation for the transformation.

The grand inauguration was graced by our esteemed Chief Guest, Shri Sudhir Kumar. The heartwarming highlight of the event was the presence of special children whose presence 
left the audience truly mesmerized — their melodious singing touched every heart and added warmth to the celebration.

The cherry on top was the enthusiastic presence of our members. Guests relished the flavors of Birhana Road ki Chaat and Kulfi, adding a festive touch to the day. Both the teachers and special children, were visibly touched by the thoughtful gifts presented to them, reflecting the spirit of gratitude and humanity. The community service aspect of the project was wonderfully led by Rtn Surabhi-Tarun Bharti, and Rtn Kanwar Preet Saluja. The project was designed by Ann Manjari-Gautam Kanodia. A big thank you to everyone involved in bringing this meaningful project to life —a symbol of unity, compassion, and progress.

activities.title: Sharbat Distribution
activities.description:
Spreading Smiles in the Heat: _Sharbat Distribution_

On 10th June .. the last Bada Mangal..It was truly a wonderful and fulfilling experience distributing sharbat during this intense summer heat. We're delighted to share that around 5,000 people benefitted from this refreshing gesture in the dry weather.

Our heartfelt gratitude goes out to all the members who took time out of their busy schedules to be part of this noble cause. Your presence made all the difference.

activities.title: Mobile Distribution At Andh Vidyalaya
activities.description:
Under the able guidance of Rtn Vijay Parikh and support of the donors on 13th August we visited Anddh Vidyalaya Junior HighSchool. This is RCKGs initiative in making a difference in the lives of challenged children. We distributed smart Mobile Phones to class 6th students. It was heartening to see how children of class 7th and 8th use their cell phones and the apps for studies and submission through mails and whatsapp. The Principal and the staff of the school is truly dedicated towards their work.

Helping to spread smiles members present were Rtm Sudhir Parswani, Rtn Vijay Parikh, Ann Karishma Parswani Rtn Abhishek Agarwal, Rtn Rahul Agarwal, Ann Shruti Agarwal and Rtn Siddharth Gupta

activities.title: Installation
activities.description:
The 29th installation ceremony of RCKG was held on 14th of July at The Sports Hub. It was a perfect evening with Anns clad in green and Rotarians in white and blue with Rajnigandha décor radiating a somber and calm ambience to the venue.

The ceremony was graced by District Governor, Rtn. Neerav Agarwal as the Chief Guest and Mr. Jogendra Kumar, DIG Kanpuas the guest of honor. The dais was set and adorned by the past team when the meeting was called to order. 
The ceremony was very beautifully and meticulously conducted by Ann Ritu Bhargava.

The installation of the new President Rtn Sudhir Parswani and his team was carried out flawlessly with the exchange of pins. The President gave his acceptance speech and presented his vision and commitment for the Rotary year along with the theme,‘Spreading
Smiles’. He was congratulated by everyone present. The Project

Directors Rtn Rakesh Kapoor, Ann

Sangeeta Kapoor and Ann Alpa

Jain Kapoor took care of every detail and smoothly navigated the

show.

The ceremony also marked the release of the first Milestones of the

year. It was beautifully unveiled on the creatively put easel by the

Editor, Chief Guest and Guest of Honor.

Presidents and secretaries from other clubs throughout the city

were invited to attend the ceremony. It is a tradition to invite them

as installation acts not only as an opportunity for club to look ahead

but also serves as an official recognition of a President’s entrance

into the Rotary leadership.

The ceremony ended with the Vote of Thanks by the newly elected

Secretary, Rtn Abhishek Agarwal and an invite to join for drinks and

dinner to everyone present.

activities.title: JIGRI JUNCTION.. Friendship Day
activities.description: The first fellowship event of the year marked the watershed movement of the new tenure. Venue was The Landmark and the theme, music, standup comedy and the stellar performance of our own Rotarians and Anns made it an unforgettable show.Kudos to the Pds and the club service team.

activities.title: Donation Of Water Cooling Machine
activities.description: Club has donated a water cooling machine with ro purifier at patel chowk civil lines bareilly

activities.title: New Year Celebration
activities.description:
दिनांक 31 जनवरी 2025 दिन शुक्रवार को सेलिब्रेशन बैंक्वेट में सपरिवार मिलन समारोह बहुत ही सफल एवं मनोरंजक रहा।
कार्यक्रम के चीफ गेस्ट AG रो अनुज तिवारी जी अपनी श्रीमती जी के साथ उपस्थित होकर कार्यक्रम की गरिमा बढ़ाई।
कार्यक्रम की शुरूआत राष्ट्रगान से हुई। 
रो दिनेश आहूजा जी ने उपस्थित सभी रोटेरियनस को Housie खिलाया।
चांद सी महबूबा होगी..... गाने की लाजवाब प्रस्तुति रो महेश गुप्ता जी ने दी।
सभी रोटेरियनस ने DJ पर डांस कर जबरदस्त आनंद लिया।
कल के कार्यक्रम को सफल बनाने मैं युवा रोटेरियन विक्रम जैन जी का महत्वपूर्ण योगदान रहा। जिन्होंने कार्यक्रम को सेलिब्रेशन बैंक्वेट में कराने का सुझाव एवं पूर्ण सहयोग दिया।
कल का कार्यक्रम सफल हुआ आप सभी रोटेरियनस की उपस्थिति से।

activities.title: निशुल्क मोतियाबिंद कैंप
activities.description:
आज दिनांक 4 फरवरी 2025 को रोटरी क्लब उन्नाव सिटी द्वारा आयोजित निशुल्क मोतियाबिंद कैंप रो डॉ नितिन चौधरी के स्वस्तिक आई एंड मेडिकल केयर सेंटर में सम्पन्न हुआ। जवाहरलाल रोहतगी से आई टीम ने कैंप में आए रोगियों के आंखों की जांच की।
मोतियाबिंद से ग्रसित रोगियों को जवाहरलाल रोहतगी आई हॉस्पिटल, गाड़ी द्वारा भेजा दिया गया। 
आज के कार्यक्रम में अध्यक्ष रो डॉ राजीव भारती, रो कांतिमोहन गुप्ता,रो दिनेश चंद्र जैन, रो डॉ नितिन चौधरी, रो माहेश गुप्ता, रो आनंद आहूजा, रो मयूर गुप्ता, रो जसमीत सिंह, रो आशीष शुक्ल, रो के जी अग्रवाल, रो मनीष सिंह,रो पवन निगम आदि उपस्थित रहे।

activities.title: बेसिक टीचर्स क्रिकेट लीग
activities.description:
Rotary Club Unnao City द्वारा प्रायोजित बेसिक टीचर्स लीग का फाइनल मुकाबला अत्यंत ही रोमांचक और उत्साहपूर्ण रहा। इस आयोजन में मुख्य अतिथि के रूप में माननीय विधायक श्री पंकज गुप्ता जी ने शिरकत की और विजेता एवं उपविजेता टीमों को पुरस्कार प्रदान किए।
फाइनल मुकाबले में Thunder Titans टीम ने शानदार प्रदर्शन करते हुए जीत दर्ज की। टीम के कप्तान श्री अविनाश मिश्रा एवं सभी खिलाड़ियों को ओमेगा आई केयर द्वारा पुरस्कार प्रदान किए गए।
वहीं, उपविजेता रही Wisdom Warriors टीम के कप्तान श्री मनीन्द्र कुमार एवं उनके साथियों को आशा हॉस्पिटल द्वारा सम्मानित किया गया। 
कार्यक्रम में Rotary Club Unnao City के प्रमुख पदाधिकारी एवं सदस्यगण विशेष रूप से अध्यक्ष रो राजीव भारती, आगामी अध्यक्ष रो दिनेश जैन, रो पवन अग्रवाल, रो राम तनेजा, रो अनुराग अग्रवाल, रो महेश गुप्ता, रो आनंद आहूजा, रो मयूर गुप्ता, रो पंकज शुक्ला, रो प्रवीण शर्मा, रो संजीव निगम, तथा रो विशाल चंद्र गुप्ता प्रमुख रूप से शामिल रहे।
विधायक जी तथा रोटीरियंस ने विजेता एवं उपविजेता दोनों टीमों को भव्य ट्रॉफियाँ प्रदान की।
इस आयोजन ने न केवल खेल भावना को बढ़ावा दिया, बल्कि शिक्षकों के बीच सौहार्द और टीम भावना को भी मजबूत किया।

activities.title: शरबत एवं बिस्किट वितरण
activities.description:
आज गुरुद्वारा साहब, उन्नाव के बाहर गुरुद्वारा कमेटी के सहयोग से शरबत एवं बिस्किट वितरण का आयोजन किया गया। इस पुण्य कार्य के माध्यम से उन्हें श्रद्धांजलि अर्पित की गई।
 
 इस सेवा में अध्यक्ष रो. डॉ. राजीव भारती, सचिव रो. डॉ. अनुराग अग्रवाल, अगामी अध्यक्ष रो. दिनेश जैन, रो. कांति मोहन गुप्ता, रो. डॉ. भरत खेडिया, रो. पवन अग्रवाल, रो अमित मिश्रा, रो महेश गुप्ता, रो अमित आनंद, रो पंकज शुक्ला, रो प्रवीन शर्मा, रो जसमीत सिंह, रो संजय त्रिपाठी, रो संजीव निगम, प्रधान सरदार अरविंदर सिंह, कोषाध्यक्ष रो विशाल चंद्र गुप्ता सहित कई रोटेरियन सदस्यों ने उत्साहपूर्वक भाग लेकर सेवा भावना को जीवंत किया।

activities.description:
साथियों आपको जानकर हर्ष होगा हमारे रोटरी क्लब ऑफ बदायूं सेंट्रल के *अध्यक्ष एवं सचिव* द्वारा एक *शाइन बोर्ड* कड़ी मेहनत से बनवाया है यह बोर्ड *रोटरी क्लब की पहचान के साथ-साथ बरेली बदायूं से आने जाने वाले लोगों का अभिनंदन करते दिखेगा*

activities.title: Radio Talk - Safe Unsafe Touch
activities.description: Rotary Club of Agra, under the leadership of President Rtn. Namrata Panicker, took its vital campaign on Safe and Unsafe Touch to the airwaves. In a special radio talk on Janvani Radio, she addressed listeners about the ongoing initiative by the club to raise awareness on child safety. With schools shut for the holidays and children spending more time at home, the club recognized this as a critical period to reach out through radio — ensuring the message of protection and awareness reaches as many families as possible.

activities.title: Plantation Program
activities.description:
To mark the occasion of World Environment Day, Rotary Club of Agra organized a tree plantation program at the proposed Selfie Point in Idgah. This initiative also marked the formal beginning of the club’s annual seasonal plantation campaign.
Under the Japanese Miyawaki method, 80 saplings of diverse species were planted in a small area. These included Pakhar, Bamboo, Karonda, Mahogany, Kanji, Kaner, Arjun, Tecoma, Jamun, and Gulmohar.
Club President Rtn. Namrata Panicker stated that the Rotary Club of Agra aims to plant 2,000 trees every year. She emphasized that the club not only focuses on planting trees but also ensures their survival through regular care and maintenance.
Members of the Rotaract Club of Agra enthusiastically participated in the plantation drive. The event was attended by Rtn. Ira Sharma, Rtn. Rajeev Lochan Bhardwaj, Rtn. Sunil Kapoor, Rtn. Amit Sisodia, and Rtn. Manoj R. Kumar. Representing the Rotaract Club, Diya Khemanani was also present.
Social activist and environmentalist Mr. Rakesh Singh coordinated the program. He shared that his mission is to promote afforestation across the city in collaboration with various social organizations, using the Miyawaki forest model.

activities.title: Mango Party
activities.description: Rotary Club of Agra organised a fellowship meet for its members on 14th June, 2025 on Mango theme. The members enjoyed games based on Mangoes and enjoyed a variety of mangoes and mango based dishes.

activities.title: Kerala Fellowship Tour
activities.description: Rotary Club of Agra organized a memorable fellowship tour to Kerala from 15th to 23rd June, 2025. More than 50 participants, including club members and their families, joined the journey, fostering stronger bonds and camaraderie within the Rotary fraternity.

activities.title: Safe Unsafe Workshop
activities.description:
s part of its ongoing mission to promote child safety and empowerment, Rotary Club of Agra conducted a special awareness workshop on Safe and Unsafe Touch at Tiny Tots Junior School, Kumarakom during its Kerala fellowship tour.

Club President Rtn. Namrata Panicker led the session, addressing young students with compassion and clarity. She explained the critical difference between safe and unsafe touch in a simple, age-appropriate manner, equipping children with the confidence to protect themselves and seek help when needed.

The interactive session focused on personal boundaries, the importance of speaking up, and identifying trusted adults they can approach in case of discomfort. The initiative reflects Rotary Club of Agra’s firm commitment to spreading awareness on child protection beyond its city borders.

This workshop, conducted during the club's fellowship tour from 15th to 23rd June 2025, highlights how meaningful service can go hand in hand with fellowship and travel.

activities.title: Contribution Of Rs. 21000/- To RC Alleppey East
activities.description:
During its recent fellowship tour to Kerala from 15th to 23rd June 2025, Rotary Club of Agra extended its hand of support to fellow Rotarians in Kerala by donating Rs. 21,000 to the Rotary Club of Alleppey East.

This contribution will aid the ongoing community service initiatives undertaken by Rotary Club of Alleppey East, which include housing projects for the underprivileged and other impactful welfare programs.

The donation was a symbolic gesture of unity and service above self, reinforcing the spirit of Rotary fellowship and collaboration across regions.

activities.title: Flag Exchange With RC Alleppey East
activities.description:
As part of its Kerala Fellowship Tour, Rotary Club of Agra marked a moment of unity and goodwill by exchanging flags with Rotary Club of Alleppey East. The symbolic exchange took place between President Rtn. Namrata Panicker and President Rtn. Dr. Aji Sarasan, highlighting the shared commitment of both clubs toward humanitarian service and global fellowship.

The gesture represented not only a warm Rotary tradition but also the beginning of a continued partnership aimed at making a meaningful difference in their respective communities. The clubs reaffirmed their dedication to Rotary’s motto — Service Above Self — and explored opportunities for future collaboration in community service projects.

activities.title: International Yoga Day
activities.description: Rotary Club of Agra marked International Yoga Day during its Kerala Fellowship Tour on 21st June, 2025 where the members joined in for a yoga session by the beach at the hotel Turtle on the Beach, Kovalam, Kerala.

activities.title: Rid 3110: Singing Competiton Finale
activities.description:
The Rotary Club of Aligarh successfully hosted the Grand Finale of the RID 3110 Singing Competition on Sunday, 08 June 2025 at Bhagat Ji Auditorium, DS College, Aligarh. The event welcomed over 25 enthusiastic participants from across the region, including Kanpur, Agra, Mathura, Bareilly, and Aligarh. 

The competition was divided into two categories: 
1. For participants aged above 50 years &
2. For those under 50, 

Ensuring a vibrant mix of experience and youthful energy. Each category saw two winners chosen based on their exceptional performances, as evaluated by a distinguished judging panel featuring Mr. Johny Foster Sb and two esteemed Annes from our club. 

The presence of DG Rtn. Neerav Nimesh Agarwal ji, AG Rtn. Divakar Varshney ji, and Rtn. Ashutosh ji EDS elevated the occasion, lending it graces and warmth. Rotarians from various cities graced the auditorium, and families in attendance thoroughly enjoyed the live musical celebration. The program culminated with a delightful serving of snacks and lunch, leaving everyone with cherished memories and a deeper sense of Rotary fellowship.

activities.title: Rss Vishal Path Yatra: Flower Showering
activities.description:
Rotary Club Aligarh participated in a solemn and meaningful civic engagement by organizing a respectful flower showering ceremony during the RSS Path Yatra on 09 June 2025. Members of the club, along with their families, assembled in advance at the designated location near Gandhi Eye Hospital, Ramghat Road, to welcome the procession with floral tributes.

The gesture symbolized Rotary’s enduring commitment to community harmony, peaceful coexistence, and mutual respect. The dignified presence and enthusiastic involvement of Rotarians added warmth and sincerity to the occasion.

This act of public fellowship not only deepened our club's connection with the broader community but also reaffirmed our values of civic respect, cultural understanding, and service beyond barriers.

activities.title: Inaugration Of RGS School Flooring Project
activities.description:
Rotary Club Aligarh proudly inaugurated the Interlock Flooring Work at RGS Jr. High School as part of its continued commitment to community development and educational upliftment. The initiative aimed to improve the infrastructure and safety of the school premises, thereby creating a more conducive and hygienic environment for learning.

The inauguration ceremony was graced by the esteemed presence of Hon’ble Mayor Rtn. Prashant Singhal, whose support for civic initiatives added significance to the occasion. Members of the club, school representatives, and community stakeholders gathered to mark this meaningful contribution with gratitude and enthusiasm.

The newly laid interlock flooring enhances both the functionality and visual appeal of the school grounds, ensuring a cleaner and safer space for students. This project reflects the core Rotary values of service, sustainability, and community partnership.

activities.title: Donation Of Water Cooler At Gandhi Eye Hospital
activities.description:
Rotary Club Aligarh proudly conducted the donation and inauguration of a Blue Star 80 Litre Water Dispenser at Gandhi Eye Hospital, Ramghat Road, Aligarh, underscoring the club’s ongoing commitment to public welfare and access to basic civic amenities. This initiative was aimed at providing clean and cool drinking water to the hundreds of patients and visitors who frequent the hospital daily, especially during the intense summer months.

The ceremony was attended by club members, hospital staff, and well-wishers from the community. The dispenser was inaugurated with grace and goodwill, reflecting the Rotary ideals of service and compassion. Members emphasized the importance of such practical interventions that directly support public health and comfort.

The event concluded with a light refreshment and fellowship program, where participants shared reflections on the club’s impactful work and reaffirmed their dedication to similar meaningful efforts.

This donation serves not only as a tangible contribution but also as a reminder that even the simplest of services—like access to clean water—can uplift lives and spread dignity.

The event concluded with a light refreshment and fellowship program, where participants shared reflections on the club’s impactful work and reaffirmed their dedication to similar meaningful efforts. This donation serves not only as a tangible contribution but also as a reminder that even the simplest of services—like access to clean water—can uplift lives and spread dignity.

activities.title: Joint Board Of Directors Meeting
activities.description:
The Joint Board Meeting of Rotary Club of Aligarh was successfully held on 27 June 2025 at Hotel Melrose Inn. 

Key discussions included:
1. Approval of previous minutes
2. Presentation of revised Club Bylaws by Rtn. Madhup Lehari (to be circulated and reviewed in the first board meeting of RY 2025–26),
3. Approval of bank signatory changes for the new session. 
4. The board respectfully accepted resignations from Rtn. Mukesh Dave & two senior members were designated as Honorary Members effective 01 July 2025 Rtn. Hari Prakash Gupta & Rtn. Rajesh Bhargava.
5. Plans for the Award Night on 6 July 2025 were finalized. 
6. Incoming President Rtn. Pramod Gupta ji shared his vision for RY 2025–26. 

The meeting concluded with fellowship and dinner hosted by senior Rotarians.

activities.title: Donation Of Water Cooler At Khair Inter College
activities.description:
Rotary Club of Aligarh proudly completed its 4th Water Cooler Donation on 28 June 2025 at 11:00 AM at Khair Inter College, Khair, a non-government-aided institution serving over 800 underprivileged students. 

This initiative was part of the club’s ongoing commitment to improving basic amenities in educational institutions and promoting student well-being. The newly installed water cooler from Blue Star with 80 Ltr capacity will provide clean and cool drinking water, especially crucial during the intense summer months. 

The event was attended by club members, school staff, and local community representatives. activities.title: Rid 3110 Award Ceremony
activities.description:
Rotary Club of Mathura Central successfully hosted the prestigious Rotary International District 3110 Award Ceremony on 29 June 2025 at Hotel Abhinanda, National Highway, Mathura. 

The event was graced by the presence of our very own District Governor Rtn. Neerav Nimesh Agarwal Ji, and witnessed enthusiastic participation from over 100 Rotarians across the district. It was a moment of immense pride for Rotary Club of Aligarh, as the club achieved an unprecedented milestone by winning the highest number of awards—31 in total—across various categories. 

Under the dynamic leadership of President Rtn. Rajeev Agarwal, the club was also honored with the prestigious “Diamond Club of the Year” award. This remarkable recognition marks a historic first in the 75-year journey of Rotary Club of Aligarh, reflecting the dedication, teamwork, and impactful service of its members. 

The ceremony was a celebration of excellence, commitment, and the enduring spirit of Rotary.

activities.title: Charter Of 1st Satellite Club Of Rid 3110 In Aligarh
activities.description:
Rotary Club of Aligarh proudly sponsored the first-ever Satellite Club of Rotary International District 3110, named the Rotary Satellite Club of Aligarh, with Club ID 223432 marking a historic milestone in the club’s legacy. The club was officially chartered under the visionary leadership of DG Rtn. Neerav Nimesh Agarwal Ji, CDS Rtn. Sonal Agarwal, and our dynamic Club President Rtn. Rajeev Agarwal. 

This initiative reflects a bold step toward expanding Rotary’s reach and engaging the next generation of leaders. A total of 64 enthusiastic members, all under the age of 45, were carefully selected from within the Rotary Club of Aligarh, which currently has 221 members. 

The formation of this Satellite Club not only strengthens the Rotary movement in the region but also ensures continuity, innovation, and youthful energy in service. It stands as a testament to Rotary Club Aligarh’s commitment to growth, leadership development, and impactful community engagement.

activities.title: Rotary Achiever's Award Ceremony - Anandam
activities.description:
Rotary Club Aligarh successfully organized a grand award ceremony titled “Ānandam” to honor outstanding contributions by club members. Hosted by Club President Rtn. Rajeev Agarwal “Raymond,” the event celebrated the achievements of 141 members across 14 prestigious categories.

Chief Guests Included:
Hon’ble Mayor Rtn. Prashant Singhal
PDG Rtn. Mukesh Singhal
DG Rtn. Neerav Nimesh Agarwal
AG CA Rtn. Diwakar Varshney

Key Awards Presented:

Rotary Ambassador, Lifetime Achievement, Legacy Maker, Rotarian of the Year, Fearless Flame, Excellence Award, among others.

President Rajeev Agarwal highlighted the basis of the awards: sustained presence, active participation in Rotary events, contribution to Rotary Foundation, and impactful community service. He also announced a ₹10 lakh fixed deposit made on 27 June for future large-scale service projects.

The evening concluded with a fellowship dinner enjoyed by Rotarians and their families, marking a new chapter in the club’s illustrious legacy.
